_comment: Estate-agent market-share tracker. Edit this file only - no pipeline code changes needed to add agents, areas or quarters.

agents.name: EXAMPLE - Replace With A Real Agent
EXAMPLE - Replace With Another Real Agent

_sources_help.what: Each entry in an agent's 'sources' list tells the collector where to read that agent's book. Three types, and an agent can have several.

type_site.comment: A listing results page. Use 'paginate' with {n} for multi-page results; omit it for a single page.

type_sitemap.comment: BEST for an agent's own site. Their sitemap.xml enumerates every property page, so there is no pagination convention to reverse-engineer and no missed pages. 'match' keeps only URLs containing that substring. Sitemap index files are followed automatically.

type_wayback.comment: The ONLY source that can reconstruct past listing data. Replays Internet Archive captures of a listing page through the same extractor, recovering what was on the market - and at what asking price - on the dates the Archive crawled. 'collapse' timestamp:6 = one capture per month, timestamp:8 = one per day.

notes: The collector reads schema.org JSON-LD, which most property sites publish deliberately for search engines. It falls back to regex extraction only if no JSON-LD is present.
robots.txt is always checked and always honoured. A disallowed URL is skipped and reported - this is not configurable by design.
Prefer the agent's own website over a portal: it is the same data, it is far more robust, it is far better archived, and it does not breach a portal's terms of use.

Wayback coverage is whatever the Archive happened to crawl. It gives a sound average list price from a single capture, but listed/relisted counts are lower bounds - anything listed and sold between two captures was never archived. The report labels these quarters 'archive' and says so.

land_registry.comment: Official HM Land Registry Price Paid Data - free, open (Open Government Licence) and already published for Q1/Q2 2026. This is the only source in this pipeline that can see the past. It has verified SOLD prices and dates but carries NO agent name, so it is joined to listings by address.
land_registry.url_note: Each year maps to a LIST of candidate URLs, tried in order until one works. HM Land Registry publishes this bucket over its S3 *website* endpoint, which is HTTP-only - that is the publisher's configuration, not a choice made here. If all candidates fail, check the current link at https://www.gov.uk/guidance/about-the-price-paid-data

metrics.relist_comment: A property must be absent (or withdrawn/sold) for at least this many days before reappearing counts as a relist, rather than a listing that briefly dropped out of a scrape.
